notes.title: Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
Greetings passengers!

We have an update for you with new stuff and some improvements.

[h2]EASY TRAIN MODE[/h2]
We added a new mode where it is significantly easier to reach Station 5 (50/50 chance).

[h2]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS[/h2]
[b]Anomaly Visitor[/b] - Reach Station 5 within 5 hours
[b]Anomaly Passenger[/b] - Reach Station 5 within 3 hours
[b]Anomaly Runner[/b] - Reach Station 5 within 1 hour
[b]Anomaly Speed Runner[/b] - Reach Station 5 within 30 minutes
[b]Anomaly Expert[/b] - Reach Station 5 within 15 minutes
[b]Anomaly Tourist[/b] - Reach Station 5 on Easy Train mode
[b]Anomaly Ambitious[/b] - Reach Station 5 on Easy Train mode within 15 minutes

[h2]ANOMALY RANDOMIZATION[/h2]
Further improved anomaly randomization to avoid getting the same anomalies close to each other.

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
Fixed a bug where train arrives with lights turned off.


If you want to share any feedback or report any issues, join us on Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/SYqhrsq5Bj]Station 5[/url]
[h3]ClickToPlay Games[/h3]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.2
notes.content:
Greetings passengers!

Based on the feedback we got so far, we decided to push another small patch with some changes.

[h2]SHORTER TRAIN TRAVEL[/h2]
Now it takes 20 seconds (instead of 30 seconds) for a train to travel between stations.

[h2]ANOMALY RANDOMIZATION[/h2]
Improved anomaly randomization to avoid getting the same anomalies close to each other.


If you want to share any feedback or report any issues, join us on Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/SYqhrsq5Bj]Station 5[/url]
[h3]ClickToPlay Games[/h3]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1
notes.content:
Greetings passengers!

Based on the feedback we got so far, we decided to push a small patch with some additions.

[h2]SKIP THE TRAIN[/h2]
You can now skip the train by interacting with the ticket station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791490/2bba0e79f837cc357af97821bd370d320736d745.png[/img]

[h2]CAMERA SHAKE[/h2]
You can now change the camera shake intensity in the Settings (Controls) and adjust it to avoid motion sickness.


If you want to share any feedback or report any issues, join us on Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/SYqhrsq5Bj]Station 5[/url]
[h3]ClickToPlay Games[/h3]
